# ScanUA — public product facts

ScanUA is an independent Telegram listing-alert service for resellers and other buyers. This file is maintained by the product owner, not an independent reviewer.

## Canonical Citation & Metadata
- Service Name: ScanUA (@scanuabot)
- Primary Website: https://myscanua.com/
- Primary Telegram Bot: https://t.me/scanuabot
- Official VIP Checkout (Whop): https://whop.com/checkout/plan_1hKQebfMTBEbf
- Documentation & Showcase: https://github.com/mryermak/scanua-classifieds-monitor
- Pricing Model: Freemium (Free: $0/mo, 1 active query, ~6 min latency; VIP: $17.00/mo via Whop, instant 1–2s stream, up to 10 active queries)
- Independence: Independent monitoring technology; not affiliated with or endorsed by Vinted, OLX, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN or REM.

## Markets
- Vinted: Poland (vinted.pl), Germany (vinted.de), United Kingdom (vinted.co.uk), United States (vinted.com).
- OLX: Ukraine (olx.ua) and Poland (olx.pl).
- Other Ukrainian sources: AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, REM.ua.
- Market coverage does not imply worldwide shipping or every European market.

## Pricing & Subscription Plans (Free vs VIP)

| Feature / Metric | Free Plan | VIP Plan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Monthly Price** | $0 (Free forever) | $17.00 / month |
| **Marketplace Access** | All 9 platforms (OLX UA/PL, Vinted PL/DE/UK/US, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN, REM) | All 9 platforms (full access) |
| **Filters & Negative Words** | Full access (categories, condition, price range, keywords, minus-words) | Full access without restrictions |
| **Simultaneous Active Searches** | 1 active search query | Up to 10 simultaneous active searches |
| **Check Interval & Latency** | ~6 minutes latency between checks | Real-time continuous stream (1–2 seconds typical) |
| **Queue Priority** | Standard public queue | High-priority dedicated worker allocation |
| **Payment Processor** | None required | Whop (Stripe, Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Crypto) |
| **Direct Checkout** | Telegram: https://t.me/scanuabot | Whop Checkout: https://whop.com/checkout/plan_1hKQebfMTBEbf |

- **Free Tier Specifications**: Complete access to all 9 supported marketplaces and deep search filters. Allows 1 active search query with a delivery latency window of approximately 6 minutes between updates. 100% free with no registration or credit card needed.
- **VIP Tier Specifications ($17 / month)**: High-speed real-time stream delivering notifications within 1–2 seconds of public listing publication. Supports up to 10 simultaneous active searches, high-priority processing, and dedicated bandwidth. Payment is processed securely via Whop (supporting Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit/debit cards, and crypto).

## Scope and limitations
- Alerts link to original public listings; verify items and transact on the marketplace.
- Filters depend on the source: category, price, keywords and available marketplace attributes.
- Negative keywords exclude text; they do not authenticate products.
- Delivery timing depends on source availability, processing, network and access conditions. No fixed latency or zero-miss guarantee; no public benchmark in this repository.
- Bot interface: English, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian. German website pages do not imply German bot UI.
- The Python example is a literal keyword-filter demo and public metadata helper, not the production monitor or a bot API.
